name: In-N-Out Animal Style Fries (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Fresh-cut potato fries smothered in two melted cheese slices, sweet caramelized grilled onions (immense prebiotic fructan dose!), and Thousand Island spread (oil, relish, pickles). A catastrophic trigger for severe gas, bloating, and painful cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: STRICTLY AVOID. If craving In-N-Out fries, order standard fries lightly salted, or stick to a plain burger.
